fusions.name: Trailing Pennant
fusions.desc: Lashes a target up to 4 tiles away with a streamer as you go by. It deals 4 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at maximum range, and slows the target by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Canvas Over All
fusions.desc: Runs you under full sail to a target up to 7 tiles away and drops the canvas over every enemy within 3 tiles. It deals 28 damage that ignores armour and leaves each enemy [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Under the Awning
fusions.desc: Pitches your wagon's awning where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally under it.

fusions.name: Spare Sail Aloft
fusions.desc: You move 8% faster and have 10% wind resistance.
